changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to full forms and simplified output descriptions. Added 'Language Model' as it was referred to as 'LM' in the paper. Removed redundant phrasing from outputs.
Consolidated metric variants to base forms as per normalization guidelines (BLEU-1/2/3/4 → BLEU, Distinct-1/2/3/4 → Distinct)
No LLM-based evaluation was used in this paper (published in 2020, before LLM-as-judge became common)

guideline: Human annotators scored generated responses on fluency (0-2 scale) and coherence (0-2 scale)
Fluency: whether response is fluent and natural
Coherence: whether response is relevant and coherent to context and knowledge information

changes_made.explanation: The extracted metadata was accurate and complete. No changes needed.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Chinese knowledge-driven dialogue generation. It evaluates both generation and retrieval models using automatic metrics (BLEU, Distinct, Perplexity, Hits@1/3) and human evaluation (fluency, coherence). The extraction was generally accurate, requiring only normalization of metric variants and model names.
